statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-18, Russian drone or missile strikes hit or damage a Dnipro River bridge in Kyiv on at least three separate calendar dates.
resolution: Kyiv Mayor Klitschko or the Kyiv City Military Administration, or two of Reuters, AP and BBC, report strikes hitting a Kyiv Dnipro bridge on three or more separate dates between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-18.
failure_condition: Fewer than three separate calendar dates between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-18 have a Russian drone or missile strike hitting a Dnipro River bridge in Kyiv.

statement: In the Brazilian presidential first round held on 2026-10-04, no candidate receives more than 50 percent of valid votes, so a runoff is required.
resolution: Brazil Superior Electoral Court (TSE) first-round results for 2026-10-04 show every presidential candidate at or below 50 percent of valid votes, triggering the runoff.
failure_condition: One presidential candidate receives more than 50 percent of valid votes in the 2026-10-04 first round.

statement: Likud wins strictly more Knesset seats than any other party list in the Israeli election held on 2026-10-27.
resolution: Israel Central Elections Committee results for the 2026-10-27 election show Likud with more seats than every other list; a tie for first place or a lower seat count resolves false.
failure_condition: Likud wins fewer seats than, or the same number of seats as, at least one other party list in the 2026-10-27 election.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent at its policy decision dated 2026-10-28. Reference: target range 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date 2026-10-03.
resolution: The Federal Reserve FOMC statement dated 2026-10-28 announces a federal funds target range whose upper bound is above 4.00 percent.
failure_condition: The FOMC statement dated 2026-10-28 keeps the target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent or sets a lower range.

statement: ICE Brent December 2026 futures settle below 95.00 USD per barrel on 2026-10-29. Reference: 102.25 USD per barrel in the packet market snapshot dated 2026-10-03.
resolution: The ICE official settlement price for Brent December 2026 futures on 2026-10-29 is below 95.00 USD per barrel.
failure_condition: Brent December 2026 futures settle at or above 95.00 USD per barrel on 2026-10-29.

statement: CISA adds a GitLab vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON carries at least one entry with vendorProject GitLab and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06 inclusive.
failure_condition: The count of KEV entries with vendorProject GitLab and dateAdded between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06 is zero.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-01, the National Hurricane Center classifies at least one Atlantic tropical cyclone at hurricane intensity, meaning maximum sustained winds of at least 74 mph.
resolution: An NHC advisory issued between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-01 lists an Atlantic tropical cyclone with maximum sustained winds of at least 74 mph.
failure_condition: Every Atlantic tropical cyclone in NHC advisories issued from 2026-10-05 through 2026-11-01 stays below 74 mph maximum sustained winds.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06, at least one person arrested in the counter-terrorism investigation into the 2026-09-27 incident near RAF Fairford is formally charged with a criminal offence.
resolution: Counter Terrorism Policing, the Crown Prosecution Service, BBC or PA report that a person arrested over the 2026-09-27 RAF Fairford incident was charged between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: Every person arrested in the 2026-09-27 RAF Fairford investigation remains uncharged on 2026-11-06.

statement: CISA adds at least one Microsoft vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON carries at least one entry with vendorProject Microsoft and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: The count of KEV entries with vendorProject Microsoft and dateAdded between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-30 is zero.

statement: Ken Paxton wins the most votes in the Texas U.S. Senate general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: The Texas Secretary of State results page, viewed on 2026-11-06, shows Ken Paxton with the highest vote total in the U.S. Senate race held on 2026-11-03, counting unofficial returns.
failure_condition: Another candidate holds a higher vote total than Ken Paxton in the Texas Secretary of State results for the 2026-11-03 U.S. Senate race as of 2026-11-06.
